Etymology tree
Aramaic דפתראder.
Proto-Hellenic *dipʰtʰérā?
Ancient Greek διφθέρᾱ (diphthérā)bor.
Classical Syriac ܕܦܬܪܐder.
Middle Persian dptl (daftar)bor.?
Arabic دفتر
Possibly borrowed from Middle Persian dptl (daftar), from Aramaic דפתרא or Classical Syriac ܕܦܬܪܐ.
